messages:
maria: Heads-up: main CI is red. gpu_e2e::memory-leak-test failing consistently after merge of PR #4890. Error shows OOM after ~120s.

ci-bot: Build 17502 failed: https://ci/redwood/17502
Failing step: run-e2e (gpu)
Log snippet:
```stderr
AssertionError: memory usage > 12GB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/gpu/memory_test.py", line 48, in test_memory_leak
    assert mem < 12 * 1024**3
```

alex: :eyes: saw this. PR 4890 touched KV cache eviction and allocator. Suspect memory regression. Can someone bisect? last green was 177f3a2

sam: I can do bisect. Need last-green and the bad commit range. maria do you have last-green sha & the bad commit sha?

maria: Last green on main: 177f3a2 (2026-03-10). First bad observed after merge of 4890 (merge commit 1780b9a).

sam: OK starting local bisect. Plan:
```bash
git checkout main
git bisect start 1780b9a 177f3a2
# run repro script
./scripts/ci/run_e2e --test gpu_e2e::memory-leak-test
```

blake: Heads-up: if bisect points at allocator change, do not revert yet. We might need a targeted fix. Ping @eng-sre and @eng-infra on call.

sam: Will run two rounds: CI bisect (fast) then local reproduce on a pinned GPU image. ETA ~ 2h. I'll post findings here and open bisect PR if needed.

alex: :thumbsup: thanks. If you hit flakiness, try `--seed=42` and increase iterations to 5. Also try `--alloc-trace` to get heap traces.

sam: Noted. Kicking off first bisect now. Starting: 1778882000

ci-bot: Re-run scheduled by @sam for build 17503 (manual).

sam: Update: bisect narrowed to commit 1780e5c (author dev-ci). It touches allocator.cpp lines 210-260. Reproduced locally with running patch. Next: open draft PR reverting the small allocator change and run CI.

maria: Nice find. Can you open revert PR and tag me + eng-oncall? We'll hold deploy until green.

sam: Opened PR 4902 revert allocator tweak. Running CI now. Link: https://git/repo/pull/4902 :rocket:

ci-bot: Build 17509 started for PR 4902.

blake: :eyes: on the PR. If tests go green, coordinate a minimal patch instead of long revert.

sam: CI passed on PR 4902. All e2e green. Reverting looks safe. Marking this as culprit: 1780e5c.

maria: Thanks all. Rolling revert to main and scheduling post-merge validation. Please add regression test for eviction path next week.

alex: Assigning follow-up: PR 4910 to add regression test and more robust allocator bounds checks. @sam will owner.

sam: Got it.
